name: Regent Shanghai on the Bund
positioning: Riverside hotel on the Huangpu River in Shanghai's Hongkou District, where the Suzhou River meets the Huangpu next to the Garden Bridge, in what was once The Seagull on the Bund hotel
best_for: Travelers who want a room with a balcony on the Huangpu River
Guests who want to be minutes from Nanjing Road and across the bridge from the main Bund promenade

facts.text: The hotel is at 60 Huangpu Road in Shanghai's Hongkou District, on the banks of the Huangpu River.
The hotel is reachable by metro lines 10 and 12.
Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport is approximately 40 minutes by car, and Shanghai Pudong International Airport approximately 1 hour by car.
The hotel is minutes from Nanjing Road, just across the bridge from the main Bund promenade.
Historic elements of the former hotel remain, including a grand piano and a white stone spiral staircase rising to the second-floor banquet rooms.
Each guestroom is designed to feel like a shipboard stateroom with an Oasis Bathroom, and the majority overlook the Huangpu River and Shanghai skyline.
The Classic Garden Bridge View Room is a corner riverfront room looking onto the Garden Bridge.
Conde, on the fifth floor, serves Western cuisine with views of the Shanghai skyline.
Jin Lin, on the third floor, serves authentic Cantonese cuisine.
Harmonia's breakfast buffet has live cooking stations, including an area to watch handmade dumplings being rolled.
Conde Boutique, just off the lobby, is a pastry shop with a show kitchen, a bar counter and a garden terrace.
The indoor swimming pool has tall windows with old Shanghai style mullions and a fountain.

highlights.text: The hotel was once The Seagull on the Bund hotel, dating back to the mid-1980s.
There are balconies in almost every room.
The hotel sits at the crossroads of the Suzhou River, next to the Garden Bridge.
The Penthouse on the Bund has 270-degree views of the Shanghai skyline and historic Bund, a grand reception hall, an outdoor terrace and a private sauna.
Harmonia is the all-day restaurant, with an open kitchen and a garden courtyard and terrace overlooking the Bund.

considerations.text: The indoor pool does not have views over the Bund.
The Conde Boutique and lobby lounge have no windows.
WhataHotel notes a busy tourist area with high foot traffic.
